business_summary: IG Port, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an animation production company in Japan, the United States, rest of Asia, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Video Production Business, Publishing Business, Copyright Business, Product Sales Business, and Other segments. The company engages in the video production projects for theatrical, television, video, streaming, and game animation and game software; planning, licensing, supervising, and production of products featuring characters from popular works; operation of stores; and manuscript magazine illustration submission and lecture activities. It also sells some rights related to the secondary use of works in Japan and overseas; and publishes and sells comic magazines, such as magazines and periodicals, comic books, illustration collections, and other related books, as well as e-books. IG Port, Inc. was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Musashino, Japan.
